---
title: "311 Heat Complaints: API Verification"
output: github_document
---

This file checks the NYC 311 Service Requests API before we download any record-level data. It confirms the field names, the complaint types related to heat, the number of HEAT/HOT WATER requests in each heating season, and how those requests split between heat and hot water.

Data source: [311 Service Requests from 2020 to Present](https://data.cityofnewyork.us/Social-Services/311-Service-Requests-from-2020-to-Present/erm2-nwe9/about_data) (NYC Open Data, dataset ID `erm2-nwe9`).

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(httr)

base_url = "https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/erm2-nwe9.csv"
retrieval_date = Sys.Date()
```

## Field names

```{r peek}
peek_response = GET(base_url, query = list("$limit" = 5))

status_code(peek_response)

peek_311 = content(peek_response, "parsed")

names(peek_311)
```

## Complaint types related to heat

```{r heat_types}
heat_types =
  GET(base_url, query = list(
    "$select" = "complaint_type, count(*) AS n",
    "$where"  = "upper(complaint_type) like '%HEAT%' AND created_date >= '2020-10-01T00:00:00'",
    "$group"  = "complaint_type")) |>
  content("parsed")

heat_types
```

## HEAT/HOT WATER requests by heating season

Each heating season runs from October 1 through May 31. The end date is set to June 1 with a strict `<` so that all of May 31 is included.

```{r season_counts}
season_bounds =
  tibble(
    season = str_c(2020:2025, "-", 21:26),
    start  = str_c(2020:2025, "-10-01T00:00:00"),
    end    = str_c(2021:2026, "-06-01T00:00:00"))

count_heat = function(start, end) {

  where_clause =
    str_c("complaint_type = 'HEAT/HOT WATER' AND created_date >= '", start,
          "' AND created_date < '", end, "'")

  GET(base_url, query = list("$select" = "count(*) AS n", "$where" = where_clause)) |>
    content("parsed") |>
    pull(n)
}

season_counts =
  season_bounds |>
  mutate(n_api = map2_dbl(start, end, count_heat))

season_counts
```

## Heat versus hot water in 2025-26

```{r descriptor_split}
descriptor_2526 =
  GET(base_url, query = list(
    "$select" = "descriptor, count(*) AS n",
    "$where"  = "complaint_type = 'HEAT/HOT WATER' AND created_date >= '2025-10-01T00:00:00' AND created_date < '2026-06-01T00:00:00'",
    "$group"  = "descriptor")) |>
  content("parsed")

descriptor_2526
```

## Follow-up checks

The first run showed that `descriptor` records the scope of a complaint (`APARTMENT ONLY` or `ENTIRE BUILDING`), not whether it is about heat or hot water. It also showed a second spelling, `Heat/Hot Water`. The checks below count complaints case-insensitively and look at `descriptor_2`, which may hold the heat versus hot water detail.

```{r season_counts_upper}
count_heat_upper = function(start, end) {

  where_clause =
    str_c("upper(complaint_type) = 'HEAT/HOT WATER' AND created_date >= '", start,
          "' AND created_date < '", end, "'")

  GET(base_url, query = list("$select" = "count(*) AS n", "$where" = where_clause)) |>
    content("parsed", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    pull(n)
}

season_counts =
  season_counts |>
  mutate(
    n_api_upper = map2_dbl(start, end, count_heat_upper),
    n_other_case = n_api_upper - n_api)

season_counts |>
  select(season, n_api, n_api_upper, n_other_case)
```

```{r descriptor_2_by_season}
count_descriptor_2 = function(start, end) {

  where_clause =
    str_c("upper(complaint_type) = 'HEAT/HOT WATER' AND created_date >= '", start,
          "' AND created_date < '", end, "'")

  GET(base_url, query = list(
    "$select" = "descriptor_2, count(*) AS n",
    "$where"  = where_clause,
    "$group"  = "descriptor_2")) |>
    content("parsed", show_col_types = FALSE)
}

descriptor_2_counts =
  season_bounds |>
  mutate(counts = map2(start, end, count_descriptor_2)) |>
  select(season, counts) |>
  unnest(counts)

descriptor_2_counts
```

## Provenance

Queries were run on `r retrieval_date`. Across the six heating seasons from 2020-21 to 2025-26, the API returned `r format(sum(season_counts$n_api_upper), big.mark = ",")` HEAT/HOT WATER service requests (case-insensitive match).
